node.title: Budget-three fiber-four constructions pass through a rank-two gate
node.statement: For direct equal-complete fibers of size four, multiplication by the deleted-root product gives a 4 by 4 residue matrix over F(X^4). Rank four forbids a constant locator relation, while rank three forces the huge equal-degree completed blocks to share a factor, contradicting pairwise-coprime block locators. Linear K_4-e and triangle-plus-singleton have rank at least three and are excluded. Linear K_4 survives only on the exact rank-two reciprocal-quadratic locus, which contains the antipodal deleted-pair component.
